data.name: La Valise Tulum, Member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World
data.address: Carr. Tulum-Boca Paila Km 8.7, Tulum Beach, 77760 Tulum, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
In a forested areas overlooking the Caribbean Sea, this upscale beachfront hotel is 13 km from the Gran Cenote sinkhole and 89 km from Cozumel International Airport.
Rustic cabanas have free Wi-Fi, safes, and tea and coffeemaking facilities, plus open-air showers, and terraces with jungle views. Airy seafront rooms include en suite bathrooms and/or hammocks. A serene suite has handcrafted furnishings. Room service is available. There are no TVs.
Breakfast is included. There’s a casual eatery serving Mexican and Mayan cuisine, and an evening restaurant offering jungle views. There’s also a heated infinity pool. Spa treatments are available.
